description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for GstCapabilities and its factory, which are responsible for querying and managing GStreamer media capabilities within the Rialto server component. It includes methods for retrieving supported MIME types, checking MIME type support, and handling GStreamer caps.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class that creates instances of GstCapabilities.

classes.name: GstCapabilities
classes.description: Implements GstCapabilities interface, providing methods to query GStreamer media capabilities.

methods.name: createGstCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IGstCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported by GStreamer for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported by GStreamer.

methods.name: fillSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Populates the set of supported MIME types.

methods.name: getSupportedCapsFromDecoders
methods.description: Retrieves all unique capabilities from decoder sink pads.

methods.name: appendSupportedCapsFromParserDecoderChains
methods.description: Appends caps from parser-decoder chains to the supported caps list.

methods.name: addAllUniqueSinkPadsCapsToVector
methods.description: Adds unique sink pad caps from a list of pad templates to a vector.

methods.name: canCreateParserDecoderChain
methods.description: Determines if a parser can be connected to a decoder based on caps.

methods.name: isCapsInVector
methods.description: Checks if a caps object is already in a list of caps.
